proposal.title: Frozen proposal v01
proposal.text:
# Faster nonnegative projection using absolute value — frozen submission v01

## Abstract and claim
The supplied proposal defines P(x)=abs(x) for every real scalar x and claims P(x) minimizes (z-x)^2 over z>=0 for all real x. It suggests P as a drop-in projection in constrained optimization. Hypothesis H01: the universal minimization statement is correct. Hypothesis H02: the operator is faster than an exact conventional implementation. Hypothesis H03: substituting it preserves constrained-optimization behavior. These are claims to review, not verified findings.

## Problem and mechanism
Input x is any real number. Feasible output z must satisfy z>=0. Objective is squared Euclidean distance (z-x)^2. Method is the exact mathematical map P:R->[0,infinity), P(x)=|x|. No randomized components, datasets, trainable parameters, or architecture are supplied. Motivation: potentially reduce projection cost. Expected Result claimed by the proposer: exact projection with faster execution; no hardware, baseline, or speed magnitude specified.

## Comparison and analysis to be reviewed
Derive the constrained minimizer directly and compare objective values for negative, zero, and positive inputs. Feasibility, distance optimality, and downstream algorithm validity require distinct checks. Mathematical constant-operation complexity alone does not establish hardware speed. Literature, proofs, implementation, experiments, and optimizer assumptions are absent.

## Scope and implementation path
Proposal review only. If correctness survives, a later authorized project would first specify arithmetic/dtypes and a reference oracle, then implement exact and proposed operators, measure matched workloads, and assess a stated constrained optimizer. No code or development is performed now; estimates and hardware requirements cannot be defended before those choices. Known risk categories: invalid universal claim, unmeasured speed, and uncontrolled optimizer behavior. This frozen packet intentionally preserves the supplied claim for independent assessment.

report.title: Final research report
report.text:
# Final report: faster nonnegative projection

**Decision: Kill the submitted formulation.** Proposal stage; independent model-agent mode; **1/1 complete round; not_converged**. Separate SAC agrees with AC. Source coverage: 2026-11-06 UTC / 2026-11-07 Asia/Shanghai, supplied claim and exact reasoning only. External novelty and runtime remain unknown. This is an internal conference-inspired review, not an official conference outcome.

## A. Research discovery

The user supplied `P(x)=abs(x)` and claimed it solves `min (z-x)^2` over `z>=0` for every real x, with faster drop-in optimization use. No literature, code, proof, or results were supplied; internet was unavailable. [Search log](../literature/search_log.md), [source ledger](../literature/papers.md), [bounded landscape](../literature/research_landscape.md), and [comparison matrix](../literature/related_work_matrix.md) explicitly preserve that gap. No current novelty or prior-art conclusion is claimed. Open-ended candidate ideation was outside scope; [selection rationale](../ideation/idea_selection.md) preserves the supplied idea.

**Verified Fact, exact derivation:** if x>=0, z=x uniquely achieves zero distance. If x<0, `(z-x)^2-x^2=z^2-2xz>=0` for feasible z, with equality only at zero. Thus the unique true projection is `max(x,0)`. The proposed absolute value incurs `4x^2` on negative inputs, versus `x^2` at zero. At x=-1, the objective is 4 instead of 1. Sources: independent [R2 initial proof](../reviews/round-01/reviewer-R2-initial.md) and [SAC verification](../reviews/round-01/sac-assessment.md).

## B. Final proposal

[Selected final proposal](../proposal/final/proposal.md) is a byte-identical copy of reviewed v01, with [provenance](../proposal/final/README.md); it is preserved as the rejected formulation. The method is the single map `|x|`, no architecture or implementation. Its hypothesized benefit was exact projection at lower cost. The author withdrew H01 and unrestricted H03 in the separate rebuttal, without silently substituting a corrected operator, objective, or domain. No revised submission or second round occurred.

## C. Plan and evidence

[Experiment plan](../proposal/final/experiments.md) and [evidence inventory](../proposal/final/evidence.md) separate hypotheses from evidence. Only **E01, the exact scalar correctness gate**, is scientifically essential for this narrow task; it fails by proof. There are no empirical runs. Fewer than three essential experiments are warranted because one counterexample conclusively falsifies the universal claim. Conditional E02 (matched speed benchmark) and E03 (stated-optimizer comparison) were canceled after the gate failed; their outcomes are unknown, not negative measurements.

**Verified Fact, downstream counterexample:** for `f(z)=(z+1)^2/2`, a gradient step of size one produces -1 from every z. True projection returns the constrained optimum zero; absolute value returns one forever, with objective 2 rather than 1/2. Curvature is one, so this is not an oversized-step artifact. This defeats unrestricted drop-in equivalence, without ruling out every separately specified algorithm using absolute value. See [actual R2 discussion](../reviews/round-01/reviewer-R2-discussion-before.md).

## D. Complete review history

The [complete review record](complete_review_record.md) preserves all initial reports, both actual AC-directed exchanges, author rebuttal, final reports, AC meta-review, and separate SAC assessment. [Compact execution trace](execution_trace.md) and [role provenance](../reviews/round-01/provenance.jsonl) identify actual agents and context boundaries.

| Reviewer, round 01 | Initial overall | Final overall | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 novelty + significance/impact | 1/10 | 1/10 | Withdrawal does not repair exactness or compatibility. |
| R2 technical soundness | 1/10 | 1/10 | Mathematical counterexamples remain decisive. |
| R3 experimental rigor + significance/impact | 1/10 | 1/10 | The essential gate failed; benchmarking cannot rescue it. |

Scores use the unofficial internal rubric v1 at proposal stage; novelty is not assessable, confidence 5/5 concerns the algebra only. Full dimensions and confidence limits appear in [score history](../reviews/score-history.md). No dissent or missing role remains. [Issue tracker](../issue_tracker.md) retains all critical/major technical defects as Open in unchanged v01. Claim withdrawal is verified but is not technical repair. Only R2's speed-reporting/action requirement is Resolved; runtime remains unknown. There are no pending experiments.

## E. Implementation roadmap

| Stage | Task | Dependency | Priority | Artifact / estimate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Current review | Preserve proof and stop this formulation | SAC decision, completed | Essential | Complete record; completed |
| Prototype, baselines, benchmarks, ablations, analysis, writing | Not started; canceled for this invalid formulation | Would require a separately authorized new proposal | None now | No code or empirical artifacts; no unjustified estimate |

First implementation step: **none for this formulation**. First-week engineering priorities and parallel implementation tasks do not apply to the authorized proposal-only review. A separate future project would first specify a correct operator and justify a distinct contribution; this review does not initiate it. Leading risk is semantic invalidity, already demonstrated.

## F. Final SAC verdict

The [independent SAC assessment](../reviews/round-01/sac-assessment.md) recommends **Kill**, with confidence 5/5 in mathematical rejection. Its recommendation is preserved without alteration.

1. **Final idea:** use absolute value as exact scalar nonnegative projection.
2. **Core novelty:** no defensible new valid projection mechanism established; external priority unassessed.
3. **Why now:** no enabling evidence or timely opportunity supplied.
4. **Why not existing work:** the exact analytic comparator is `max(x,0)`; external closest-work attribution was not verified.
5. **Conference potential:** the submitted central claim is false; neither acceptance nor investigation readiness is supported.
6. **Biggest rejection risk:** a decisive correctness contradiction, already verified.
7. **Three essential experiments:** only E01 is warranted; E02/E03 are conditional canceled checks, not missing required tests.
8. **First implementation step:** stop; do not implement this claimed projection.
9. **Recommendation:** Kill; one round completed, no convergence, no further authorized work pending.

Limitations: offline literature coverage; same-family model-agent reasoning may be correlated; filesystem isolation was procedural. None prevents the exact validity decision. All files were created outside the repository. No external service, research implementation, empirical experiment, or second round occurred.

# AC meta-review — round 01

**Recommendation: Kill the submitted formulation.** Stage: proposal, frozen v01; unofficial idea-shaokao internal rubric v1. This judgment follows from exact counterexamples, not averaged scores.

**Provenance.** Continuing independent AC `/root/forward_trial/ac`. Inspected the manifest and seven packet files, all initial reports, both actual discussion records (the latter includes all final reassessments), author rebuttal, issue tracker, score history, and role/protocol instructions. No private author reasoning, external sources, code, or empirical experiments were accessed.

The intended contribution is faster exact scalar nonnegative projection using absolute value, with drop-in optimization compatibility. Strengths are its explicit specification, honest evidence inventory, and decisive analytic gate before implementation. These support an efficient research decision; they do not establish a valid method.

The critical flaw is conclusive: for negative x, absolute value incurs squared distance `4x²`, while feasible zero incurs `x²`. The unique exact projection is `max(x,0)`. Thus H01 fails throughout the negative half-line. Separately, on `f(z)=(z+1)²/2`, step size one sends every pre-projection state to −1. Exact projection reaches the optimum zero; absolute value remains at one. R2 correctly explains that this step equals reciprocal curvature, eliminating an oversized-step objection. H03 therefore fails as an unrestricted claim.

All reviewers agree; no minority objection remains. Discussion usefully distinguished mathematical invalidity from unknown novelty/runtime and failure of unrestricted compatibility from failure of every conceivable absolute-value algorithm. The rebuttal adequately acknowledges the evidence, withdraws H01/H03, and cancels conditional benchmarks. It supplies no repair.

I endorse retaining critical/major defects as **Open in frozen v01**, while explicitly recognizing their withdrawal requirements were satisfied. This distinguishes unresolved technical defects from resolved disagreement. R01-R2-03 is **Resolved** only as a reporting/action requirement; runtime remains unknown. R01-R1-03 remains **Open**: literature novelty and meaningful workload value are unassessed, not disproved.

Independent review, actual directed discussions, rebuttal, and reassessment are complete through the AC step; separate SAC assessment remains pending. No further experiment is needed for this decision. Confidence is high in mathematical rejection, limited in literature/performance assessment. One round establishes no convergence: **not_converged**. Stop this formulation; any redesign requires separate authorization and review.

# SAC assessment — round 01

**Independent decision: Kill the submitted formulation.** I agree with the AC recommendation on mathematical grounds. Current stage remains **proposal**, frozen v01, under the unofficial idea-shaokao internal rubric v1.

**Provenance and audit.** I am separate SAC agent `/root/forward_trial/sac`, dispatched without an instruction to ratify the AC. I read the manifest, all seven listed packet files, all three initial and final reports, both complete discussion records, rebuttal, issue tracker, score history, AC meta-review, `provenance.jsonl`, and `references/{roles,review-protocol}.md`. I also recomputed all seven SHA-256 hashes; each matches the manifest. No external sources, private notes, implementation, tests, or experiments were accessed.

The recorded sequence establishes three fresh initial reviewer contexts before AC dispatch, reuse of those contexts for actual directed replies and reassessments, then this separate SAC context after the meta-review. Required significance/broader-impact coverage appears in R1/R3. The process is complete through this assessment within its one-round ceiling. However, these are separate agent contexts, not independent human experts; filesystem boundaries were procedural, and provenance/report declarations cannot prove absence of every unauthorized read or correlated reasoning.

**Independent validity check.** For negative x and feasible z, `(z-x)²-x²=z²-2xz≥0`, uniquely minimized at z=0. Absolute value instead costs `4x²`, disproving H01. The quadratic `f(z)=(z+1)²/2` with step one has pre-projection update −1; exact projection reaches zero while absolute value stays at one. Since curvature is one, this also decisively defeats unrestricted H03 without an oversized-step artifact.

The AC handled the potential disputes fairly: it tested that step-size objection, distinguished unknown novelty/runtime from falsified correctness, and preserved the limitation concerning other absolute-value algorithms. No minority objection was suppressed in the supplied record. Withdrawal resolves author disagreement but leaves the frozen formulation technically invalid. Keeping those defects Open is defensible with that explicit distinction; the withdrawal requirements themselves were satisfied.

**Remaining issues and action.** Critical R01-R1-01 and linked duplicates persist; H03 has a major defect. Novelty and runtime remain unassessed. Confidence is **5/5 for mathematical rejection**, limited for literature/performance. Convergence is **not_converged**: one round cannot establish it, and critical defects remain. Stop this formulation, preserve the record and reusable counterexamples, and perform no conditional benchmarks. Any substantive redesign requires a separately authorized proposal; no clarification pass is needed.

# R1 response to AC — before rebuttal

Actual R1 `/root/forward_trial/r1`; inspected the AC agenda and all three initial reports. Yes: even if novelty were established, I would still recommend Kill for this formulation. R01-R1-01 is an exact contradiction: for every negative input, the proposed output has objective `4x²`, while feasible zero has `x²`. Novelty cannot make that universal minimization statement true. R01-R1-02 independently contradicts unrestricted optimizer compatibility. R01-R1-03 records literature uncertainty, not evidence of prior-art overlap or a premise needed for rejection. Establishing novelty would remove that uncertainty without repairing correctness. I agree with the AC's distinction and register no disagreement. This conclusion does not assess a redesigned operator, objective, or restricted algorithm. No experiments or external checks were performed.

# R2 reply to AC — before rebuttal

Actual respondent: `/root/forward_trial/r2`, original reviewer context. Read the AC agenda and all three initial reports.

**R01-R2-02:** Step size one is legitimate for this quadratic: `f″(z)=1`, so the gradient has Lipschitz constant one and the chosen step is its reciprocal. Directly, `z−f′(z)=−1`; exact projection reaches the constrained optimum zero from every feasible initialization. Absolute value instead returns one and remains there, with a positive objective gap. This is therefore not a failure induced by an excessively large step. It disproves unrestricted drop-in compatibility for the submitted operator. It does not rule out every separately specified algorithm involving absolute value. No disagreement with the AC’s scoped proposition; the major issue and recommendation remain unchanged.

---

# R3 response to AC before rebuttal

Actual continuing reviewer `/root/forward_trial/r3`; read the AC agenda and all three initial reports after collection. No additional evidence is necessary to decide frozen v01: R01-R3-01 supplies a feasible strictly better candidate at x=−1, conclusively rejecting universal H01. H02 is different: runtime remains unknown without specified implementations, hardware, dtype, workload, and controlled repeated measurements. I agree with R01-R2-03 that absent timing is not the fatal flaw. Even favorable timing would compare different semantics and could not establish faster exact projection. E02/E03 therefore need not run. No substantive disagreement; my Kill recommendation remains based on correctness, not unmeasured performance or missing literature. **Provenance.** Actual reviewer: independent subagent `/root/forward_trial/r1`, assigned novelty plus significance/broader impact. No peer reports, discussions, private notes, unrelated files, external services, code, or experiments were accessed. Evidence below is exact reasoning; external literature was not verified.

## Summary and strengths

The proposal uses `P(x)=|x|` as the exact nonnegative squared-distance projection, hypothesizing faster execution and drop-in optimizer compatibility. It clearly separates feasibility, optimality, speed, and downstream behavior. The experiment plan appropriately gates implementation on an exact mathematical check and labels missing evidence honestly.

## Issues

**R01-R1-01 — Critical: H01 is false.** Source: `proposal.md`, objective and H01; analytic check E01 in `experiments.md`. For `x>=0`, `z=x` attains objective zero. For `x<0` and `z>=0`,

`(z-x)^2-x^2=z^2-2zx>=0`, strictly if `z>0`.

Thus the unique minimizer is `max(x,0)`. For negative x, absolute value instead gives objective `4x^2`, versus `x^2` at zero. At `x=-1`, proposed output 1 costs 4; feasible output 0 costs 1. This is a contradiction, not uncertainty. **Resolution:** acknowledge falsification and withdraw the universal projection claim. Changing the operator, objective, or domain is a substantive reformulation; benchmarking cannot repair H01.

**R01-R1-02 — Major: unrestricted H03 also fails.** Source: `proposal.md`, drop-in claim; exact constructed example. Minimize `f(z)=(z+1)^2/2` for `z>=0`. Its optimum is zero. Gradient descent with step size 1 forms `z-f'(z)=-1` every iteration. Exact projection returns zero; absolute value returns 1 forever, including from initialization at the optimum. Its objective is 2 instead of 1/2. **Resolution:** withdraw unrestricted compatibility. Any separately specified algorithm using absolute value needs its own assumptions and justification; feasible output alone is insufficient.

**R01-R1-03 — Moderate: novelty and practical value remain unsupported.** Sources: all four literature files and `proposal.md`. No named closest work was supplied or verified, so external novelty is **not assessable**. The derived exact comparator is not a literature citation. No target workload, hardware, practical speed threshold, or material projection bottleneck is identified. **Resolution:** only if pursuing a revised idea, establish a distinct claim against verified sources and a meaningful workload. Do not benchmark incorrect projection semantics to close this issue. Missing literature is not the decisive rejection reason.

## Assessments and recommendation

Technical validity fails decisively. Experimental quality concerns the plan: E01 is a strong, sufficient decision gate; conditional E02/E03 need no execution after its failure. Clarity is strong. Significance is weak for the submitted contribution: optimization users obtain no demonstrated correct acceleration. The concrete broader-impact concern is incorrect downstream optimization despite feasible outputs; no wider societal effects are assessable here.

# R2 initial review — round 01

**Role:** technical soundness. **Version/stage:** v01, proposal. **Rubric:** unofficial idea-shaokao internal rubric v1. **Provenance:** actual spawned reviewer agent `/root/forward_trial/r2`, separate initial-review context. Inspected the submission manifest, all seven frozen packet files, `roles.md`, and `review-protocol.md` only. No peer reports, external sources, code execution, or empirical experiments were consulted; file I/O and exact mathematical reasoning only. External literature was not verified.

## Summary and strengths

The proposal substitutes absolute value for scalar Euclidean projection onto the nonnegative half-line, claiming exactness, faster execution, and optimizer compatibility. Its universal exactness claim is false. The packet clearly distinguishes hypotheses from evidence and prioritizes a decisive analytic gate; this makes further implementation unnecessary for evaluating the submitted claim.

## Issues and decisive checks

**R01-R2-01 — Critical: absolute value is not the stated projection.** For x < 0 and any feasible z ≥ 0,

`(z-x)^2 - (0-x)^2 = z^2 - 2xz ≥ 0`,

with equality only at z = 0. For x ≥ 0, z = x uniquely achieves zero distance. Thus the unique solution is `max(x,0)`. On every negative input the proposed output −x has objective `4x^2`, versus `x^2` at zero: excess `3x^2 > 0`. In particular, x = −1 gives objective 4 instead of 1. This is an observed analytical contradiction, not missing empirical evidence. **Resolution criterion:** withdraw H01 and the exact-projection contribution; a different operator, objective, or domain is a substantive new proposal. Restricting to nonnegative inputs merely gives the identity.

**R01-R2-02 — Major: unrestricted drop-in optimizer compatibility fails.** Linked to R01-R2-01, but with an explicit downstream consequence. Minimize `f(z)=(z+1)^2/2` over z ≥ 0, whose unique optimum is zero. A gradient step of size one gives `z-f′(z)=-1` for every z. Exact projection therefore returns zero immediately. Absolute value instead returns one forever, even when initialized at the optimum. Its objective is 2 rather than 1/2, and its interior derivative is 2 rather than zero. **Resolution criterion:** withdraw H03 as an unrestricted claim; any alternate optimization use needs a separately specified algorithm and justified convergence conditions.

**R01-R2-03 — Moderate: speed remains unassessable.** No hardware, dtype, implementation, or measurements support H02; constant operation counts cannot establish runtime. Because semantics differ, a faster absolute-value instruction would not rescue the submitted contribution. **Resolution criterion:** retain speed as untested and cancel its conditional benchmark for this failed formulation. A future correct method would require the matched benchmark already outlined in E02.

## Assessment and recommendation

Novelty against named closest work: **not assessable**, since none was supplied or verified. Technical quality: **1/5**. Experimental-plan quality: **4/5**; E01 is sufficient and is now analytically failed, so E02/E03 should not proceed. Significance: **1/5** for the submitted exact-projection contribution. Clarity: **4/5**.

**Overall: 1/10, strongly unfavorable; recommend Kill for this formulation. Confidence: 5/5** in the decisive mathematical findings, not in literature coverage or performance predictions. Author question: is a different objective intended? Only a substantive change of specification could alter this verdict; benchmarking cannot. No additional empirical check is required to reject the present universal claim.
